# Naviamp 2.11.3

Naviamp 2.11.3 fixes Java4Shell on Windows and Linux and corrects the Microsoft Store taskbar icon.

## Bug fixes

- Update the bundled Java runtime on Windows and Linux to fix Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938). ([Issue #613](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/613))
- Remove the blue background behind the taskbar icon in the Microsoft Store build. ([Issue #614](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/614))

## Upgrade notes

- Install the updated Naviamp package to replace its bundled Java runtime.
- Store and Flatpak updates may arrive separately.

## Known issues

- No new known issues.
